source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Wheels and Tires, p.10-1

procedures.title: Wheels and tires: general description
notes: All 1968 Chevrolet lines come with welded steel wheels held by five studs and nuts to the front hub or rear axle flange.
All Corvettes use 15 in. diameter wheels, 7 in. wide.
Do not fit tire chains on Corvette rear wheels: there is not enough tire-to-wheelhouse clearance.

Factory tires at the recommended pressures carry full rated load at all normal highway speeds; optional lower pressures for more comfort are allowed only with the reduced loads shown in the Recommended Tire Inflation Pressure table (Specifications, Section 10).
Optional 8-ply rating or larger tires add service margin (e.g. towing) but never raise the car's rated load.

procedures.title: Tires: inflation and inspection
steps: Set pressures from the Vehicle Capacity Rating and Recommended Tire Inflation Pressures table in Specifications, and check them periodically.
Every few thousand miles and at every lubrication, look for stones and sharp objects in the tread.
Repair punctures with a tire manufacturer's repair kit.

procedures.title: Tire wear: diagnose
steps: Misalignment wear: excessive toe-in or toe-out makes the tire scrub sideways and scrape off tread. Severe error wears both front tires (or all four); slight error may affect just one.
